concerns.text: FR-001 requires separate ingestion of RootReader and PlantPheno datasets plus ISRIC soil data, but Task T006 downloads a pre‑merged HuggingFace dataset, thereby weakening the required data‑source acquisition and merging steps.

FR-002 mandates merging root phenotype data with ISRIC soil data using geographic matching and nearest‑neighbor interpolation (≤10 km). Task T006 bypasses this merging process by using an already merged dataset, violating the explicit functional requirement.
FR-012 requires exclusion of experimental root data (data_source_type == "experimental"). No task explicitly filters or validates this condition, leaving the requirement unimplemented.
SC-001 (merge_success_rate) is not addressed by any task; there is no computation or reporting of the proportion of root phenotype datasets successfully merged with soil nutrient data.
SC-004 (total plot size ≤ 100 MB) is absent from the task list; no verification step ensures visualization output stays within the size constraint.
SC-007 (causal‑language lint check) is missing; the pipeline does not include a step to scan the final report for prohibited causal wording.

The spec (US‑1) specifies a minimum of 20 observations per species, yet Task T007 enforces a minimum of 30 observations per species, altering the acceptance criterion (SC‑005) without explicit staging, constituting an undocumented requirement change.

SC-005 expects reporting of the proportion of species excluded due to insufficient sample size (n < 20). The tasks enforce n ≥ 30 and do not produce the required metric, breaking the success‑criteria specification.
